title: [SUPERSEDED -> folded into 0003] Kid-friendly explanation & presentation layer
description: SUPERSEDED 2026-06-02: folded into 0003-web-front-end by user decision during 0003 planning. Do NOT plan separately. Its scope - translating the engine's raw RaceResult into plain-language, visual, age-appropriate output ('where did your speed go?', the 'why', trajectory for animation) - is now owned by 0003, which implements it as a pure Python translation module (pinewood_derby/present.py) feeding the web UI. The age-range open question it carried is resolved in 0003: target audience is 12-17. Retained as a backlog record for history; no PRD/TRD will be authored here. ORIGINAL: Spun off from 0001-physics-engine during planning (2026-06-02) as the UI/translation layer over RaceResult.
